summary: BNY is executing a platform-centric transformation under CEO Robin Vince. Reorganised around platforms operating model (50%+ workforce, full by 2026). Delivered 500bps operating leverage improvement. Q2 2025: $5.0B revenue (+9%), $1.93 EPS (+27%). Record sales: $1T+ new AUC/A wins generating $145M new servicing fee revenue. Key strategic moves: Archer acquisition ($1.2B), Eliza AI platform, AI Hub, unified commercial model, Dublin Digital R&D Hub. BNY serves as critical infrastructure for global capital markets.
